messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend).  

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 2** | Monday | Observed New Year’s Day | (See above) |
| **February 20** | Monday | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, PE) | Observed on Monday |
| **March 17** | Wednesday | St. Patrick’s Day (NS) | Not a statutory holiday |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | (Observed on Monday) |
| **April 10** | Thursday | Easter Monday (Ontario, Quebec, NB, PE, NL, BC, AB, SK, MB, YT, NT, NU) | Observed on Thursday |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | Observed on Monday |
| **June 19** | Monday | Canada Day | Observed on Monday |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day (observed on Monday, July 3) | Observed on Monday |
| **July 3** | Monday | Observed Canada Day | (See above) |
| **September 4** | Monday | Labour Day | Observed on Monday |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving | Observed on Monday |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day | Observed on Monday |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Observed on Monday |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Observed on Tuesday |

### Long‑Weekend Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates Covered | Total Days Off |
|--------------|---------------|----------------|
| New Year’s | Dec 31 – Jan 2 | 3 days (Sat‑Mon) |
| Family Day | Feb 18 – Feb 20 | 3 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 10 | 4 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Victoria Day | May 20 – May 22 | 3 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Canada Day | Jun 17 – Jun 19 | 3 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | 3 days (Sat‑Mon) |
| Labour Day | Sep 2 – Sep 4 | 3 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 7 – Oct 9 | 3 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 5 – Nov 7 | 3 days (Fri‑Mon) |
| Christmas | Dec 23 – Dec 26 | 4 days (Fri‑Mon) |

> **Note:** Some provinces observe different holidays (e.g., Family Day is not observed in Ontario, Manitoba, or Newfoundland & Labrador). The table above reflects the most common long‑weekend dates across Canada.

Feel free to copy this into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific details or additional holidays (e.g., provincial holidays), let me know.
